impact_en: Turkish Morphological Analyzer (HFST) is a research/specification repository rather than a verified shipped analyzer. Its README and Mermaid diagrams describe a layered FST pipeline across lexicon, morphotactics, phonology, derivation, and a compiled-analyzer target. The audited workspace contains documentation and marker README files under fst/lexicon and fst/rules, but no compiled HFST artifact, so the dossier makes the implementation boundary explicit.
impact_tr: Turkce Morfolojik Analizor (HFST), dogrulanmis olarak yayinlanmis bir analizorden cok arastirma ve spesifikasyon reposudur. README ve Mermaid diyagramlari sozluk, morfotaktik, fonoloji, turetim ve derlenmis analizor hedefinden olusan katmanli FST pipeline'ini tanimlar. Denetlenen workspace fst/lexicon ve fst/rules altinda dokumantasyon ve ornek README dosyalari icerir, ancak derlenmis HFST artefakti icermedigi icin dossier uygulama sinirini acikca belirtir.

adrs.title: Model morphology as layered finite-state transducers
adrs.context: The system overview separates lexicon, morphotactics, and phonology into pipeline layers.
adrs.decision: Keep lexical, morphotactic, and phonological concerns as separate FST stages.
adrs.tradeoff: Composition order and boundary contracts must be defined before compilation.

adrs.title: Represent derivation as recursive part-of-speech transitions
adrs.context: The derivation diagram documents transitions such as noun-to-verb and verb-to-noun.
adrs.decision: Treat derivation as transitions that can return to inflection after a part-of-speech change.
adrs.tradeoff: Recursive derivation increases ambiguity and requires bounded composition rules.

adrs.title: Separate specification from compiled output
adrs.context: The audited workspace documents the compiled analyzer target but does not contain a compiled HFST artifact.
adrs.decision: Publish the repository as a research/specification record until build artifacts and executable tests are present.
adrs.tradeoff: Runtime performance and coverage cannot be claimed from the current source snapshot.
